Net present value requires todays cashflow be reinvested at some rate of return. Dynasty assets are depreciating assets...so it doesnt work.
Rule of thirds would disagree.

If you look at an entire cohort, the only year a player is expected to increase in value is from rookie year to their second year( just based on different statistical Studies I’ve seen). All other years they are expected to decline in value. 

I know the Time Value of Money argument is often made, but I made my comment because I believe it’s a fallacy.  I think assets can be more valuable today than tomorrow, but it would have to due to the risk the league ends. Inevitably, someone will be caught holding the bag with future assets someday.  

That’s a risk that must be evaluated on a case by case basis.
